plugins.name: hwpx-docs
plugins.description: Make, read, edit and check HWPX (OWPML) and HWP (HWP 5.0) documents for Hancom Office Hangul

plugins.name: hwpx-docs-forms
plugins.description: Optional add-on of hwpx-docs: layout rules of official Korean forms (measured on real 별지 서식) as packs, so a new form gets the page, fonts, label shading, lines and parts of its family

plugins.name: hwpx-docs-privacy
plugins.description: Optional add-on of hwpx-docs: the model sees pseudonym tags instead of the personal data that its rules find in Hangul documents; real values stay in a local vault and return when a document is written. A guard against slips, not a boundary
